title: 第80章 国强，是真的有出息了
content_zh:
第80章 国强，是真的有出息了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

林美丽也带了礼物。

一块布料，的确良的，淡蓝色。

“二嫂，给你做件褂子。”

赵素梅接过来：“美丽，破费了。”

林美丽笑了笑，没说话。

那笑容，有点勉强。

寿礼摆了一桌子。

林国伟送了一双布鞋。

林国栋送了一顶帽子。

林美玲送了一件自己做的毛线坎肩。

林美丽送了两瓶酒。

林国强和赵素梅送的是一件中山装，深灰色的，在县城百货大楼买的。

林海柱摸着中山装的料子，手有点抖。

“这得多少钱……”

“爹，您别管多少钱。”

林国强说，“今天是您六十大寿，穿新衣裳，精神。”

林海柱没说话，舍不得穿，把中山装叠好，放在手边。

开席了。

林国强亲自掌勺，八凉八热，一道道端上来。

红烧肉、糖醋鱼、四喜丸子、扒鸡、卤味拼盘……

村里来吃席的亲戚邻居，筷子都没停过。

“这菜，比县城的大饭店还地道！”

“林家老二这手艺，绝了！”

“老林头好福气啊，儿子这么出息！”

林海柱坐在上首，听着这些话，脸上的褶子都舒展开了。

他端起酒杯，抿了一口。

是好酒。

老二专门备的洋河大曲。

他看了林国强一眼。

老二正给赵素梅夹菜，低声问她累不累。

林海柱把酒杯放下了。

心里头，说不清是啥滋味。

老大老三坐在旁边，闷头吃菜，一句话没有。

这寿宴是他们三家出钱办的，但面子里子，全是老二的。

菜是老二做的，店是老二的，连亲戚邻居夸的，也是老二。

他们俩，就是来凑份子的。

林海柱心里明镜似的。

以前他觉得，老大是长子，得偏着点。

老三是小儿子，得多疼点。

老二老实，吃点亏没啥。

可现在呢？

老大除了占便宜，还能干啥？

老三连自己都养不活，还要他贴补。

只有老二，不声不响地撑起了一片天。

林海柱又端起酒杯，闷了一口。

席散后，亲戚邻居陆续走了。

一家人坐在店里喝茶。

Chapter 80 Guoqiang is really promising - "Reborn at 80, taking his wife and daughter to eat and drink after the separation"

Lin Meili also brought gifts.

A piece of fabric, fine, light blue.

"Second sister-in-law, let me make you a gown."

Zhao Sumei took it: "Beautiful, it's a waste."

Lin Meili smiled and said nothing.

That smile was a bit forced.

A table was laid out for birthday gifts.

Lin Guowei gave me a pair of cloth shoes.

Lin Guodong gave a hat.

Lin Meiling gave me a woolen waistcoat made by herself.

Lin Meili sent two bottles of wine.

What Lin Guoqiang and Zhao Sumei gave as a gift was a dark gray Chinese tunic suit bought at the county department store.

Lin Haizhu touched the material of the tunic suit, his hands shaking a little.

"How much does this cost..."

"Dad, don't worry about how much it costs."

Lin Guoqiang said, "Today is your 60th birthday. Wear new clothes and be in good spirits."

Lin Haizhu said nothing and was reluctant to wear it. He folded the tunic and put it at hand.

The banquet is open.

Lin Guoqiang personally took the spoon, serving eight cold and eight hot dishes one after another.

Braised pork, sweet and sour fish, Sixi meatballs, braised chicken, braised meat platter...

Relatives and neighbors from the village who came to have a feast never stopped using their chopsticks.

"This dish is more authentic than the big restaurants in the county town!"

“The Lin family’s second son’s skills are amazing!”

"Old Lintou is so lucky to have such a promising son!"

Lin Haizhu sat at the top, listening to these words, the wrinkles on his face relaxed.

He picked up the wine glass and took a sip.

It's good wine.

Yanghe Daqu specially prepared by Lao Er.

He glanced at Lin Guoqiang.

The second child was picking up vegetables for Zhao Sumei and asked her in a low voice if she was tired.

Lin Haizhu put down the wine glass.

In my heart, I can’t explain what it feels like.

The eldest and the third child sat nearby, eating vegetables without saying a word.

The birthday banquet was sponsored by the three families, but all the honors belonged to the second oldest.

The food is cooked by the second child, the store is owned by the second child, and even the relatives and neighbors praise him as the second child.

The two of them are just here to join in the fun.

Lin Haizhu felt like he had a clear mind.

He used to think that since the eldest son was the eldest son, he had to stay on the sidelines.

The third child is a younger son, so it will hurt more.

The second brother is honest, it’s okay to suffer a little loss.

But now?

Besides taking advantage, what else can the boss do?

The third child can't even support himself, so he still needs supplements.

Only the second child held up the sky silently.

Lin Haizhu picked up the wine glass again and took a sip.

After the party, relatives and neighbors left one after another.

The family is sitting in the shop drinking tea.
